create_autoguidance_instance: create an AutoGuidance instance with guidance_scale, auto_guidance_layers, and dropout for skip layer guidance
apply_layer_skip_hook: apply layer skip hooks to a denoiser model for AutoGuidance skip layer guidance
run_auto_guidance_forward: run AutoGuidance forward to combine conditional and unconditional noise predictions with guidance scale
prepare_denoiser_models: prepare and cleanup denoiser models by registering and removing AutoGuidance skip layer hooks
rescale_noise_predictions: rescale noise predictions using guidance_rescale to fix overexposure in diffusion outputs
